job.title: [Post] Poojashri S' Post
job.email_subject: Application: Quality Engineering role at Coforge
job.email_body:
Dear Poojashri S.,

Thank you for your Coforge quality engineering post – I bring 5+ years of Java and SAP Commerce engineering with JUnit test automation, UAT support and code reviews.

– JUnit unit and integration test suites
– UAT with product owners and business teams
– REST/SOAP API know-how and CI/CD release cycles

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for Coforge.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Java & SAP Commerce Engineer | Quality Engineering, JUnit Testing & UAT
tailoring.summary: Java and SAP Commerce Cloud engineer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation, Shell and Cognizant, with a strong quality focus. Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit, supported user acceptance testing (UAT) with business teams and performed code reviews. Experienced in REST and SOAP web services, OCC APIs, SQL, production troubleshooting and CI/CD release cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile teams. Uses AI tools extensively to accelerate testing and documentation. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Coforge delivers quality engineering for global enterprise clients, and I know that enterprise world from Rockwell Automation, Shell and Cognizant. I want to combine my Java, API and SAP Commerce background with testing and UAT work in client projects where deep platform knowledge raises quality. I look forward to contributing.

en.subject: Application: Quality Engineering role at Coforge
en.hook: Quality engineering works best when the tester understands the code and the business process behind it. I bring both: more than five years as a Java and SAP Commerce engineer at Rockwell Automation, Shell and Cognizant, where I built JUnit test suites, supported UAT with business teams and reviewed code before release.

bullets.label: Test automation
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit to maintain code quality and coverage.

bullets.label: User acceptance testing
bullets.text: Gathered business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes and supported UAT.

bullets.label: API quality
bullets.text: Consumed and exposed REST and SOAP web services and developed OCC APIs, giving me a deep understanding of how integrations should behave and fail.

bullets.label: Release quality
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production issues and executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).
